records.request: build me a dashboard for this scholarship sheet - status, marks, income, which talukas, that kind of thing
write me a short report summarising the scholarship applications for our board

attempts.raw:
{
  "title": "Scholarship Application Summary",
  "subtitle": "Overview of applicant demographics, status, and academic performance",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Applicants",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM scholarship_applicants",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Average Marks %",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(\"Marks %\") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants",
      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "pie",
      "title": "Application Status Distribution",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Status\" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1",
      "x": "status",
      "y": ["count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Applicants by Category",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Category\" AS category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC",
      "x": "category",
      "y": ["count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Average Marks by District",
      "sql": "SELECT \"District\" AS district, AVG(\"Marks %\") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC",
      "x": "district",
      "y": ["avg_marks"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Top Performing Applicants",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Naam\", \"School\", \"Marks %\", \"Name of scheme\" FROM scholarship_applicants ORDER BY \"Marks %\" DESC LIMIT 10"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "The current scholarship cycle has processed {{p1.total_count}} total applications. The cohort maintains an average academic standing of {{p2.avg_marks}}%.\n\nApplication processing is distributed across various stages, as shown in the status breakdown. The demographic profile is primarily driven by the {{p4.category}} category, while academic performance varies across districts, with the highest average marks seen in {{p5.district}}.\n\nDetailed records of the highest-scoring candidates are available in the top performers table for further review."
}
